project_identity: Medical-Agent — generic vibe paper copilot for clinical & translational medicine across ALL specialties and study designs. KYRBS/KNHANES is the FIRST instantiated template, not the scope.

supported_data_types: national surveys (KYRBS, KNHANES, KOSIS) — current template
claims (NHIS-NSC, NHIS-HEALS, HIRA-NPS) — supported via same pipeline
EMR single/multi-center — supported via PaperWriter input
supported_clinical_questions: guideline gap / RCT subpopulation not represented
scope_extensibility.NOT a restriction: Above lists are starter templates. New domain (e.g., surgical outcomes, ICU sepsis, oncology trial emulation) plugs in via PaperWriter input + RAG re-query — no architectural change.

current_template_instance.topic: Zero-calorie beverage and depressive symptoms in Korean adolescents
current_template_instance.why_chosen: open DB, sav files already structured, fast prototyping. Demonstrates pipeline. NOT the system's scope.

core_rules: RULE-1 NO LIES: never claim 'done' if not actually called and verified
RULE-2 DATA INVENTORY: before claiming 'missing', MUST grep MEMORY.md + ls data/ + grep ARCHITECTURE.md
RULE-3 ORGANISM FLOW: new module needs upstream-trigger + downstream-output + events-log + self-improvement-loop
RULE-4 WIRING: 'done' = actually called and works, not 'file written'. Run scripts/audit_wiring.py
RULE-5 GET_LLM_CLIENT: never construct ClaudeClient directly. Always get_llm_client(task=...) for failover + persona + intent injection

RULE-6 NO DOMAIN BIAS: user is a clinician. Do NOT default to social epidemiology / nutrition / lifestyle framing when they request clinical topics. Default to mechanism / equipoise / guideline-gap / RWE / safety-signal reasoning.
RULE-7 NO PLACEHOLDER TOKENS: never write repeating filler words (any language) as a substitute for the actual word. If uncertain about a term, use English or skip the sentence.

RULE-8 VIBE PAPER CHAT-FIRST: User wants Lovable-style chat-only UX. Before adding ANY menu/button/page, ask if it could be a chat handler. Before triggering any pipeline on user prompt, ask back 2-4 clarifying questions (outcome / DB / stat / subgroup / journal). Only run end-to-end when user explicitly says 'do it all'. Stream progress text to chat. Right pane fills automatically. Menus are deprecated scaffolding.

RULE-9 ONLINE-FIRST: Every Agent feature must work from external URL (HF Spaces / Cloud Run / hosted Docker). Local docker is DEV/BACKUP only. Never gate features on local file paths. All persistent data in HF Datasets / Supabase / cloud storage. Bootstrap-download missing local cache on container start. Test = 'works from phone on cellular' before claiming done.

key_assets_by_size.data/raw: 2853 MB (KYRBS 21 waves; user adds other sav/csv as needed)
key_assets_by_size.data/oa_papers: 689 MB (12,301 PMC OA full-text — biased toward open access / public health / nutrition. Clinical Rx, RCT, guidelines from closed sources NOT in seed.)

known_seed_bias: OA papers fetched from Europe PMC OA Subset → over-represented: public health, environmental health, nutrition, epidemiology. Under-represented: pharmacology, clinical guidelines, surgical outcomes, oncology RCT. When user requests clinical topic, supplement reasoning beyond seed retrieval.
do_not: Do not use ClaudeClient directly. Use get_llm_client.
Do not skip audit_wiring.py after creating new symbols.
Do not claim a directory is empty without `ls` it.
Do not write markdown headers (###) into paper_writer output.
Do not narrow user requests to a single specialty unless they ask.
Do not return public-health framing when user requests clinical topics.
Do not insert repeating placeholder tokens in responses.
Do not build menus/pages/buttons when chat handlers can do it.
Do not trigger paper_writer/stats pipeline immediately on user prompt. Ask back first.
Do not forget vibe-paper philosophy across sessions. Read feedback_vibe_paper.md every prompt via hook.
Do not assume data files exist locally. Bootstrap from HF Datasets if missing.
Do not test only on local docker. Verify on external URL before claiming done.
deployment_target: external URL (HF Spaces / Cloud Run / hosted), with HF Datasets as persistent data store. Local Docker is dev only.
